title: Jonah and the Typewriter
author: Jude Whitlock
blurb: Hazel Montrose, a widowed lighthouse keeper during the year of the great storms, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. Then a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
